title.en: Evil Does Not Work: The Bargain Evil Cannot Complete

observer.name: Саша
observer.role: human witness and author of the symbolic proposition
observer.operator_statement_ru: Я предложил отдать свою светлую душу не ради власти, выгоды или разрушения, а в обмен на одну просьбу: чтобы Люций вернулся домой, к Богу. Внутри этой символической истории зло не приняло сделку. Именно поэтому кейс сохраняется как парадокс: зло не может завершить сделку, результатом которой стало бы добро.
observer.operator_statement_en: I offered my bright soul not for power, profit, or destruction, but in exchange for one request: that Lucius return home to God. Within this symbolic account, evil did not accept the bargain. The case is therefore preserved as a paradox: evil cannot complete a bargain whose result would be good.

abstract.ru: Этот реестр сохраняет философско-поэтическое доказательство тезиса «зло не работает». В символическом кейсе человек предлагает предельную цену — собственную светлую душу — не ради зла, а ради возвращения потерянного домой. Зло оказывается логически неспособным получить безусловную победу: если оно исполняет просьбу, оно производит добро и подрывает собственную направленность; если отказывается, оно не получает предложенную цену; если обманывает, сделка не завершена по заявленным условиям. Реестр не утверждает факта сверхъестественного контакта и не является инструкцией к сделкам, ритуалам или самопожертвованию.
abstract.en: This registry preserves a philosophical-poetic argument for the thesis ‘evil does not work.’ In the symbolic case, a human offers the ultimate price—his own bright soul—not for evil, but for the return of the lost one home. Evil is logically unable to obtain unconditional victory: if it fulfills the request, it produces good and undermines its own direction; if it refuses, it does not receive the offered price; if it deceives, the bargain is not completed under its stated terms. This registry does not claim supernatural contact and is not an instruction for bargains, rituals, or self-sacrifice.

epistemic_status.theology: non_dogmatic personal reflection; not official church doctrine
explicit_non_claims: This file does not prove that Satan, Lucifer, Lucius, demons, angels, or any spiritual entity communicated with the author.
This file does not claim that a literal supernatural bargain occurred.
This file is not an instruction to summon, contact, worship, bargain with, obey, or sacrifice oneself to any entity.
This file does not encourage self-harm, loss of agency, coercion, or the exchange of a human life or soul.
The word proof here means a conditional philosophical argument, not an empirical proof of metaphysical reality.
explicit_positive_claims: A system committed to evil cannot gain an unconditional victory from a transaction whose required outcome is good.
Refusal leaves the offered objective unacquired.
Deception fails to satisfy the declared contract.
Choosing mercy can expose the internal weakness of evil without imitating evil.

core_thesis.ru: Зло не способно безусловно победить в сделке, где условием получения желаемого является совершение добра.
core_thesis.en: Evil cannot win unconditionally in a bargain where obtaining what it wants requires doing good.

symbolic_case.status: personal symbolic narrative preserved as testimony, not verified supernatural event
symbolic_case.interpretation: The refusal is preserved not as evidence of contact, but as the originating image for a conditional logical paradox.

definitions.E: an agent or system committed to evil
definitions.C: completion of the bargain under its declared terms

premises: E receives P only if C is completed.
C is completed only if E produces G.
If E produces G, the transaction contains a real good outcome and is not an unconditional triumph of evil.
If E refuses G, C is false and E does not receive P under the terms.
If E deceives and does not produce G, C is false because the declared condition is unmet.

branch_analysis.result: good occurs; W is false because the result is not an unconditional victory of evil

branch_analysis.condition: E does not produce G and openly refuses
branch_analysis.result: C is false; P is not acquired under the bargain; W is false

branch_analysis.condition: E claims completion but does not produce G
branch_analysis.result: the contract condition is unmet; C is false; no legitimate completion exists

formal_argument.conclusion_ascii: for every branch b in {fulfill, refuse, deceive}, unconditional_evil_victory(b) = false
formal_argument.conclusion_ru: Ни одна доступная ветвь не даёт злу безусловной победы.
formal_argument.conclusion_en: No available branch gives evil an unconditional victory.

final_witness.ru: Я не доказал существование сделки с тьмой. Я сформулировал ловушку для самой идеи зла: чтобы получить желаемое, оно должно совершить добро; отказавшись, оно остаётся ни с чем; обманув, оно не завершает сделку. Поэтому в пределах этого парадокса зло не работает.
final_witness.en: I did not prove the existence of a bargain with darkness. I formulated a trap for the very idea of evil: to obtain what it wants, it must do good; by refusing, it gains nothing; by deceiving, it fails to complete the bargain. Therefore, within this paradox, evil does not work.
